title.zh: 授权美国政府或其任何机构的某些官员在菲律宾主持宣誓与证言的法案
title.en: An Act to Authorize Certain Officials of the Government of the United States or Any Agency Thereof to Administer Oaths and Affirmations in the Philippines
title.orig: An Act to Authorize Certain Officials of the Government of the United States or Any Agency Thereof to Administer Oaths and Affirmations in the Philippines

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1949/ra_385_1949.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any person sent to the Philippines by the Government of the United States, or any agency thereof, to whom authority is delegated by the said Government or agency, to administer oaths and affirmations, to aid claimants for benefits granted by the United States in the preparation and presentation of their claims, and to make investigations and examine witnesses, shall have authority to administer oaths and affirmations during his assignment in the Philippines in any investigation or matter connected with the performance of his duties and functions: Provided, however, That for any oath or affirmation administered by him, no fee shall be charged or collected.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 17, 1949.
